title: search-api elevated latency on a subset of queries
summary: A cache warm-up after a routine deploy left a subset of long-tail search queries served from cold cache, raising p95 latency for nine minutes. No errors were returned and no query failed; results were correct throughout.
root_cause: cache warm-up lag following routine deploy #4602
resolution: cache warmed naturally; no intervention required beyond monitoring

impact.outage_class: degraded latency on a query subset (not an outage)
impact.note: Post-hoc figures reconciled from the edge logs. Small enough that no customer raised a ticket, which is why the closing note is a courtesy rather than a requirement.

timeline.event: p95 latency on long-tail queries rose; INC-2024-1028 opened
cache warm; latency returned to baseline
